description.en: A whole-animal reconstruction with a long neck, long legs, three-toed feet and a short mobile muzzle. Retracted bony nostrils do not establish trunk length; the soft nose, skin, ears, tail and colour are conservative inferences.
description.zh: 完整活体复原，具有长颈长腿、三趾足与短活动吻。后移的骨性鼻孔不能确定鼻长，软鼻、皮肤、耳尾及颜色为保守推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole animal: long camel-like neck, long legs, three-toed feet and raised retracted nasal region. Conservative short mobile muzzle, no assumed elongated trunk.

scientific_limits.en: Composite living reconstruction based on NHM partial Darwin specimen and 2023 correct mounted skeleton comparison. Figure3C MLP12-14244 (text also prints12-1424) includes mount restoration. NHM about3m body length is estimated, not a measurement of photographed mount or atlas specimen. PIMUZ A/V5700 atlas measurements are separate. Retracted bony nasal aperture does not determine soft nostril position or trunk length; short mobile lip/nasal pad is conservative inference. Skin, ears, tail and color inferred. Do not use erroneous bovid atlas shown in Fig3A/AMNH14489.
scientific_limits.zh: 综合活体复原，NHM达尔文部分标本与2023正确展骨对照；Fig3C编号12-14244而正文亦作12-1424，含展架补配。约3米是NHM全体估计，不是照片或寰椎标本实测。PIMUZ5700寰椎尺寸单独列示。后移骨性鼻孔不能确定软鼻孔位置及鼻长，采用保守短活动上唇鼻垫推定。皮耳尾色推定；不得用Fig3A及AMNH14489的错误牛寰椎。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Panperissodactyla, Litopterna, Macraucheniidae; not camel or elephant.

scale.status: Atlas values reported in2023 Table1 cm, independent specimen. Whole model dimensions estimates; no giant mass-to-length conversion.

diagnostic_targets: Long curved upright neck distinct from trunk-like muzzle; clear cervical transition at shoulder.
Long weight-bearing four limbs with visible joint transitions and three compact toes each, not camel two-toed feet.
Elongate skull with high retracted nasal zone distinct from ordinary horse forward nostril; external short nasal pad conservatively inferred.
Moderately deep long torso with no camel hump, rhino horn, elephant tusks or long hanging proboscis.
Complete living animal with small inferred ears and tapering tail, not skeleton-only or head-only.

reference_credits.title: More than100 years of a mistake: on the anatomy of the atlas of the enigmatic Macrauchenia patachonica
